# Chase Golden Globe

> Chase Golden Globe Pty Ltd is a private international business and investment platform founded in 2006 by Fouad Barhoum and headquartered in Sydney, Australia. It began by importing fine furniture and handicrafts from Indonesia into Australia, later re-exporting to Europe and the Middle East, before expanding into food and agricultural products, luxury real estate and interior design (via a 2010 venture with Royalty Prussia), and international investment. It is present in ten countries: Australia (head office), Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Algeria, Egypt, the United Kingdom, Switzerland and Luxembourg, across four regions: the Gulf, North Africa, Europe and Southeast Asia.

Founder Fouad Barhoum built an international network through the company's early trading operations and went on to study finance, risk assessment and market analysis. He now works as a connector between investors and projects. On every engagement the house carries out due diligence, investor reporting and pitch preparation; its network extends to sovereign wealth funds, government-linked institutions and state-owned companies. The company's guiding philosophy is "Start small. Think big. Go fast."

Core capabilities: structured project and export finance; capital structuring and risk; impact and sustainable investment; government and institutional liaising; bankability and project readiness; capital raising; mergers and acquisitions; private equity advisory; joint ventures and alliances.

Sectors: agriculture and food security; energy; infrastructure; retail and hospitality; industrial manufacturing; cross-border trade connecting Africa, the Middle East and Asia; real estate and luxury development; oil and gas; mining and natural resources.

## Notes

- Founder: Fouad Barhoum. Founded: 2006. Head office: Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.
- Contact: info@chasegoldenglobe.com.au
- Languages: the site is available in English, Arabic and Indonesian (browser-side switch).
- Licensing: Chase Golden Globe Pty Ltd is not itself a licensed financial services provider. Regulated activities are delivered in partnership with appropriately licensed practitioners and firms. See the Legal & Privacy page.
